core_principles: High-Contrast, Sunlight-Optimized: Ensure 7:1+ contrast ratio on data points for outdoor readability.
Literal Icons: Use explicit iconography (e.g. realistic crop shapes) rather than abstract vectors.
One-Handed Navigation: Large 48px+ touch targets in the lower third of the screen, adapted for 'fat-finger' errors.
Role-Based Simple Views: Progressive disclosure that tailors views for Campesinos (production), Vets (scheduling), and Urban Consumers (marketplace).

instructions_to_main_agent: Design mobile-first. Prioritize bottom navigation for core user tasks since farmers operate one-handed in fields.
Implement high contrast colors: Always use #1C1C1C for text on light backgrounds to ensure readability outdoors under sunlight.
Data-testid is MANDATORY. Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements, e.g., data-testid='add-product-btn'.
Use literal language. Avoid abstract tech jargon (e.g., instead of 'Dashboard', use 'Mi Finca' or 'Mis Cultivos').
Do NOT use glassmorphism. It reduces legibility outdoors. Use solid backgrounds with crisp 1px borders and distinct shadows.
Make touch targets large: Minimum 48px height for all buttons and inputs.
Images should have a max-height of 40vh on mobile to prevent losing context of the page.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Target 7:1 for text-to-background to account for harsh outdoor sunlight.
accessibility.motion: Use minimal, purposeful motion. Support prefers-reduced-motion.
